item.tib: bon dang chos kyi brda don rnam bshad
item.coloph: ces pa 'di ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa ris med la dad pa'i snang ba rgyas pa khod spungs dbra zhig ston pa bskal (skal) bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis/ rang gi slob ma mang pos 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ sba zhabs seng ge gnam rdzong gi gnas mdun nags tshal stug po'i lding khang du dge sbyor la brtson pa'i thun mtshams su bris pa'o//
